name: Re’em (Playable Unicorn)
body:
The re’em are intelligent, sacred unicorns who have sworn ancient pacts with the natural world and civilized orders to protect forests and innocent souls. Standing on four swift hooves with a glowing spiral horn, they bring celestial purity and curative grace to the battlefield.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Re’em possess celestial presence, fleet reflexes, and boundless vitality, but are headstrong and innocent. They gain +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma, and -2 Intelligence.
Type: Magical Beast. Re’em are magical beasts.
Size: Large. Re’em take a -1 size penalty to AC, a -1 size penalty on attack rolls, a +1 size bonus to CMB and CMD, and a -4 size penalty on Stealth checks. They occupy a 10-foot by 10-foot space and have a natural reach of 5 feet.
Speed: Very Fast Speed. Re’em have a base land speed of 50 feet.
Languages: Re’em begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Bonus languages include Celestial, Draconic, and Elven.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Darkvision: Re’em can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
Low-Light Vision: Re’em can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Sacred Hide: Thick hide provides a +2 natural armor bonus to AC.
Purity (Ex): Re’em gain complete immunity to poison and magical charm and compulsion effects.
Offense and Magic Racial Traits
Horn and Hooves: A re’em gains a primary horn attack dealing 1d8 points of piercing damage (plus Strength modifier) and two secondary hoof attacks dealing 1d4 points of bludgeoning damage each (plus 1/2 Strength modifier).
Healing Horn (Sp): Three times per day as a standard action, a re’em can touch a creature with its horn to heal 1d8 points of damage + 1 point per character level as cure light wounds.
Quadruped: Re’em receive a +4 racial bonus to CMD against trip attempts and gain quadruped carrying capacity.
